name: Classic Fitness Academy
evidence: The official homepage identifies Classic Fitness Academy as a fitness training and education academy offering personal trainer certifications, fitness courses, and diplomas, establishing it as a specialized training institution.
notes: The supplied www hostname failed DNS resolution; the same-domain apex hostname served the matching Classic Fitness Academy site.
Normal TLS to the apex hostname produced the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error, so curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests.
